source_visual_observations: Parallel upper AB and lower CD; triangle ACE with C=70°; AE bisects CAB; the target is exterior angle AED.
audit.independent_solution: CAB=180−70=110°. AE bisects CAB, so EAB=55°. Angle AED is supplementary to the corresponding55° angle, giving125°, choice B.
